provenance.note: The ground-truth bake ran torch on GPU, outside flopscope's instrumentation. These are closed-form FLOP counts: the per-operation cost model is the one flopscope charges for the numpy reference implementation (validated against a live flopscope run to the unit), evaluated at the chunking the torch bake actually used. The bake was NOT budget-limited; flop_budget is recorded equal to flops_used so that flop_budget - flops_used == flops_remaining holds. It is unrelated to the estimator's Phase-2 evaluation budget of 2**41 FLOPs per MLP.
